title: Paloma and the Trail
author: Rosalind Joubert
blurb: Petra Dunmore, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
